pageProps.title: The Little Prince
pageProps.review: A review of Antoine de Saint-Exupéry's work, reread as an adult, containing reflections on the emotions that feel new every time depending on accumulated experience and mood, and the differences in translations by publisher.
pageProps.description: So I'm a little bored. But if you tame me, my life will be as bright as if it were hit by sunlight.
pageProps.content:
## Review I reread it occasionally as I get older. It's new every time I read it. Content seems to change slightly depending on the accumulated experience and the mood and atmosphere at the time of reading.
It also seems to change slightly depending on the publisher that translated it. I can't read French, so the original version is impossible...
